Responses to this EOI will be evaluated in accordance with the EOI Conditions and against the following evaluation criteria: 1. Management capability, key personnel, subcontractors and testing laboratories. 2. Experience and reference projects/contracts. 3. Risk Management and WHS. 4. Environmental, Social and Governance considerations. A maximum of six respondents will be shortlisted and invited to submit tenders for the proposed contract.
:

Request for expressions of interest - HAZMAT Register Review and Associated Services

:

Respondents must include with their response completed Confidentiality Privacy and Conflict of Interest Deed.

:

1. The Respondent is a legal entity at the Closing Time. 

2. For Trusts only: if the Respondent is responding to this EOI as a trust, please attach a copy of any relevant trust deed(s) and / or documents that authorise the Respondent’s Authorised Contact to represent and legally bind the Respondent.

3.The Respondent accepts the EOI Conditions (Part B).  

4. The Respondent agrees, and requires any subcontractors to agree, to abide by the Harbour Trust Supplier Code of Conduct. 

5. The Respondent has declared any actual, perceived or potential conflict of interest to the Harbour Trust. 

6. The Respondent organisation and its directors have declared any judicial decision against them relating to employee entitlements or workplace health and safety, taken in the last 3-years.

7. The Respondent organisation and its directors have declared any finding of dishonest, unethical or unsafe practices, taken in the last 3-years. 

8. The Respondent has completed each Part C Response Schedule, in English.   

9. If successful, the Respondent agrees to obtain and maintain the insurances as set out in the draft contract.

10. The Respondent has completed the Confidentiality, Privacy and Conflict of Interest Deed. 

11. The Respondent has downloaded each addendum. 

:

Shortlised tenders will be notified by Friday 6 November with RFT published Monday 9 November 2026. Dates are subject to change.
